metadata.content:
*It doesn't need to make sense. Just say it with emotion.*

| **Magic, [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged)** |   **Maneuver** |
|-------------------|---------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged) 10**  | **🎯 Special** |

**Effect:** Choose one of the following effects:

- You orate a rousing tale of [victory](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/victories). One ally within [distance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance) gains an [edge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/edge) on the next [power roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) they make before the start of your next [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn).
- You weave a tale of high-stakes heroics. One ally within [distance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance) gains 1 [surge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/surge).
- You insult a foe where they're most vulnerable. One enemy within [distance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance) takes a [bane](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/bane) on the next [power roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) they make before the end of their next [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn).

**Spend 1 Drama:** You can choose two targets for the chosen effect.
